description: Ontology for representing contractual compliance facts, controls, risks, and assessments grounded in source contract evidence.

entities.description: A legal agreement subject to compliance evaluation.
A logical section or clause of a contract containing compliance-relevant language.
A compliance requirement derived from internal policy or regulatory standards (Table 1 of the assignment).
A technical or administrative safeguard required or referenced in the contract.
An atomic, evidence-backed assertion extracted from a contract indicating the presence or absence of a control.
A gap, exception, or missing obligation that negatively impacts compliance.
A derived compliance assessment for a specific requirement.

relations.description: Indicates that a contract contains a specific section.
Indicates that a contract section contains language relevant to a compliance requirement.
Links a contract section to a normalized compliance claim extracted from it.
Indicates that a claim mandates or requires a specific security control.
Indicates that a claim provides positive evidence toward satisfying a compliance requirement.
Indicates that a contract section introduces a compliance risk or gap.
Indicates that a risk negatively affects a compliance requirement.
Indicates that a compliance result is derived for a specific requirement.
Links compliance claims to the final compliance result for auditability and grounding.
